title: The WP Recipe Maker WordPress plugin before 10.9.2 does not check whether the post a recipe is embedded in is password…
description: A vulnerability in the WP Recipe Maker WordPress plugin before version 10.9.2 allows unauthenticated users to access the full content of recipes embedded in password-protected posts. This occurs because the plugin does not verify whether the post containing the recipe is password protected before returning recipe data via its REST API and structured data output.
